# `aitbc node island leave`

Leave an island by its ID.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc node island leave [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--island-id` | text | — | yes | The Island id. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc node island leave --island-id <island_id>
```
